lang.name: English
meta.title: GTNH Crop Breeding Planner (CropsNH)
meta.description: Plan CropsNH breeding in GregTech: New Horizons 2.9. Tick the seeds you hold and see what you can make next, the odds for any pair of parents, and the route to a goal crop. Read straight out of the mod.
rail.title: Your seeds
rail.progressLabel: Share of all crops you hold
rail.legendSub: needs a specific block under the soil
manage.about: Your ticks live in this browser. The hosted page and a local copy keep separate stores - use this box to move the list between them.
manage.dlnote: This page runs in a sandboxed frame, so it cannot write files. Use Copy and paste the text somewhere safe - the offline copy of this page can download instead.
foot.data: Extracted from the bytecode of cropsnh-2.0.101.jar, as shipped in GTNH 2.9 - recipes, pools, soils, sub-soils and light requirements come straight out of MutationLoader, CropLoader and SubSoilRequirementLoader, not from a wiki. Nothing else in the pack registers crops with CropsNH, so the list above is the whole set rather than a selection.
foot.privacy: Your ticks are stored in this browser and nowhere else. The page makes no external requests and works offline - move a list between copies from Manage list in the sidebar.
msg.badFormat: Unrecognised format - paste a code from this tool.
msg.noneKnown: Found no known crops in that - nothing was changed.
msg.loadedUndo: · Undo is at the top of this panel
msg.cleared: Cleared ${undoState.length} crops - Undo is right above.
msg.clipboardBlocked: Clipboard is blocked - the box is selected, press Ctrl+C.
msg.downloadRefused: The browser refused the download - use Copy instead.
